name: ReqPad Mobile API Client
free_limit: Free forever local mobile API client for REST/HTTP and WebSocket requests, Basic/Bearer/API-key/JWT authentication, collections, environments, request history, cURL import/export and 5 optional AI actions per month. No account or card required for core local features.
watch_out: Free edition excludes GraphQL, gRPC, MQTT, Socket.IO, MCP, pre-request/test scripts, Collection Runner, advanced authentication and most imports; those require Pro. Pro offers a separate 7-day trial and paid subscriptions. Third-party APIs may charge independently. Optional AI actions send limited data to external inference; secrets are filtered locally. Proprietary mobile app, not open-source or hosted API capacity. Commercial-use permissions are not explicitly stated in the published terms; review before claiming permission.
